quotes.title: HD 17156
quotes.card: HD 17156, named Nushagak by the IAU, is a yellow subgiant star approximately 253 light-years away in the constellation of Cassiopeia.
quotes.introduction: The apparent magnitude is 8.16, which means it is not visible to the naked eye but can be seen with good binoculars.
